sonnet.problem: The right answer stands out. "Cyrus king of Babylon" is the only answer that isn't "king of Persia", while both wrong answers share that title. A baker can pick it by pattern alone.

sonnet.problem: The right answer is the only Bible-sounding, God-centered one ("angered the God of heaven"). The wrong answers are political and secular, and "broke a treaty with Persia" is out of place for Nebuchadnezzar's time. The right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
